<style id="ink-reveal-style">
/* Два исходных фото: одинаковая геометрия, плавное проявление верхнего слоя. */
.ink-portrait{display:block;position:relative;width:100%;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;isolation:isolate;box-shadow:0 24px 70px #0005;touch-action:pan-y;cursor:pointer}
.ink-portrait img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;pointer-events:none}
.ink-portrait .ink-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;height:100%;opacity:0;transition:opacity 850ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);will-change:opacity}
.ink-portrait.is-ink .ink-layer{opacity:1}
.ink-badge{position:absolute;bottom:18px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);white-space:nowrap;background:#111d;color:#fff;border:1px solid #ffffff40;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-radius:99px;padding:11px 17px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s}
.ink-portrait.is-ink .ink-badge{opacity:0}
.ink-controls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:17px 0 4px;color:#aaa;font-size:11px}
.ink-controls button{background:#f2f1ed;color:#111;min-height:44px;border:1px solid #f2f1ed;border-radius:99px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:11px;transition:background .25s,color .25s,transform .25s}
.ink-controls button[aria-pressed=true]{background:transparent;color:#fff}.ink-controls button:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.ink-portrait:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #fff;outline-offset:6px}
.hero-visual::after{display:none!important}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ink-portrait .ink-layer,.ink-controls button{transition:none}}
</style><style id="smoothui-adapted">
